blocks.text: English biologist Francis Crick ne genes ko express karne ke is tareeqe ke liye “Central Dogma” (markazi asool) ki istilah istemal ki. Central dogma kehta hai ke maloomat genes (DNA) se gene ki aik RNA copy mein jati hai, aur yeh RNA copy amino acids ki zanjeer ko tarteeb se jorne ki hidayat deti hai. Saada lafzon mein central dogma yeh hai:
Is ka matlab hai ke genetic maloomat ka bahao (flow) aik taraf hai. Jab maloomat protein mein chali jaye to woh kabhi wapas nahin aati.
Central dogma ke do qadam hain: transcription (DNA se RNA banna) aur translation (RNA ki maloomat se protein banna).

blocks.alt: Oopar se neeche bahao: oopar DNA double helix; hara teer 'Transcription (DNA -> RNA)' neeche aik strand wale RNA tak; hara teer 'Translation (RNA -> Protein)' neeche motiyon ki zanjeer jaisi protein tak.

blocks.title: Khaane ki tarkeeb ki kitab
blocks.text: DNA ko library (nucleus) mein rakhi khaanon ki tarkeebon (recipes) ki kitab samjhein. Aap aik tarkeeb ki photocopy (mRNA) le kar kitchen (ribosome) jate hain jahan khana (protein) pakta hai. Asal kitab kabhi library se bahar nahin jati.
